candidates.term: The Rival at the Month Gate
candidates.defline: At your Month Gate stands the daring colleague: the working world sees your nerve first.
candidates.reading: This position rules Career and Social, and it runs the prime of your life. The Rival stands at your Month Gate in full view: the working world reads your nerve first, the colleague who volunteers for the contest. Your prime rewards open competition, commissions, rankings, arenas with scoreboards, and it punishes vague partnerships. Allies come easily and rotate often. Through your thirties and forties, the wins are personal and the losses are usually shared bets. So compete in the open, split the prize before the race, and keep one rival you respect. They are your best coach.
candidates.teaser: At work you compete the way others breathe, and people feel it. Your career rises fastest in open contests, and slowest wherever the prize must be split.
